system.prerequisites: Inner Discipline, Arcana 8 ranks, Dragon Lore
system.description:
You have formed a bond with a dragon companion, and together, you share a deep connection. You can command your dragon to unleash devastating breath attacks, protect you in battle, and even merge your spirits to become a formidable draconic warrior.

Prerequisites Inner Discipline, Arcana 8 ranks, Dragon Lore

Special Prerequisite You must have an unhatched dragon egg before you take this feat.

You gain a Dragon Companion, which accompanies you on your adventures and faithfully obeys simple commands. More information on Dragon Companions can be found at the end of this chapter.

Progression Requirements Arcana skill +10 ranks

Automated: Use: checks Inner Discipline, 8 ranks of Arcana, the Dragon Lore specialist skill (B10-11, however gained) and an egg that has finished bonding, then hatches it: your Dragon Companion, a linked companion actor at its base level, which gains a level whenever you do (B10-1). One dragon (B10-12); a ranger keeps the wolf. With a dragon bonded, the Use is the GM's: separated (Soul Drain half its level, held, and Refocus Hard) or reunited. Its death is automated (B10-13).
